title: nervilia afzelii
intro: Nervilia afzelii, commonly known as the Elephant Ear Orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Nervilia afzelii are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which are said to promote relaxation and alleviate stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand the plant's properties and potential uses.
